'''Livien Magnus''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Battle of Ord Radama|attacked]] Ord Radama and besieged Livien Magnus, which was held by the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. About a week into the siege, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Adraas]] arrived on Ord Radama and suggested to [[Darth Malgus]], the leader of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces on the planet, that they send some [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to clear a path into Livien Magnus. Malgus agreed to Adraas' proposal and Adraas sent the droids to assault the city's southern gate, where they were quickly destroyed by the Republic defenders. However, the droids' failure provided a distraction that allowed the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Venemal]] and a team of [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] to enter Livien Magnus and blast a hole in the city's wall. Sith troops then surged into the city and Livien Magnus quickly fell to Malgus' forces.

A few weeks later, a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] attacked Malgus' [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Ord Radama, in an attempt to drive the Sith from the planet. During the engagement, a stricken Sith [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class Dreadnaught]] plummeted into the atmosphere of Ord Radama and crashed into the center of Ord Radama, destroying Livien Magnus and [[Death/Legends|killing]] one hundred thousand of the city's residents. The Sith subsequently abandoned Ord Radama and the city [[New Raido]] replaced Livien Magnus as the world's capital.

By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Livien Magnus was rebuilt and [[Rialla Way]] was by then a major thoroughfare of the city. It was [[Bombing of Rialla Way|bombarded]] by [[Malau Jocaos]] in an attempt to turn [[Var Narek]] to the Imperial cause, with the bombing blamed on the Rebel Alliance.

==Behind the scenes==
Livien Magnus was created by [[Daniel Wallace]] and featured in the [[2012]] publication ''[[Star Wars: Book of Sith]]''. Wallace intended the city to be a reference to the [[Livien League]], a [[Pre-Republic era|pre-Republic]] empire that was ruled by the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]].<ref name="Book of Sith endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_15.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 2)}}</ref>
